name: bing_search
description: Search the web using Bing and return the extracted result text. Opens the results page, reads the result list (the #b_results items), and returns the readable content so the agent can follow up with read_dom, query, or click. Use this for quick web searches instead of navigating to a search engine manually.

maxChars.description: Truncate the extracted results to this many chars. Default 200000.
